name: alma/faq-accordion
title: Faq Accordion
description: An accordion list of frequently asked questions.

description.label: Description
description.default: Reduce hesitation with smart answers. Use collapsible questions to address common concerns without overwhelming the layout.

q1.label: Question 1
q1.default: Is this app free to use?

a1.label: Answer 1
a1.default: Yes, there is a comprehensive free tier available for all new users. Premium features can be unlocked via the Pro subscription.

q2.label: Question 2
q2.default: How does the 30-day money back guarantee work?

a2.label: Answer 2
a2.default: If you're not completely satisfied with our service within the first 30 days, simply contact our support team to receive a full refund, no questions asked.

a3.label: Answer 3
a3.default: Our application is fully supported on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and modern web browsers.

q4.label: Question 4
q4.default: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?

a4.label: Answer 4
a4.default: Absolutely. You can cancel or pause your membership directly from your account dashboard with zero hidden fees.
